notes.title: v1.01 fixes Windows 7 compatibility issues reported by some users
notes.notes:
Version 1.01 of Vulture Island was uploaded this Tuesday, and based on reports from Windows 7 users that previously had problems running the game, it seems everything works as expected now. :)

Thanks for all feedback and please let us know if any other issues arise.

The Donut Games team
